interval.scope: Opt-in terrain, material-emission and lighting submissions on the shared device. Enable before warmup to observe incoming work. Work submitted before capture is enabled, ore/feature/vine jobs, copies, driver compilation and untimestamped work are not covered. Host sequence marks classify whole submissions; device timestamps use a separate clock. Boundary-crossing and aborted submissions are excluded from pass aggregates. Pending work is not awaited. Union removes overlapping pass timestamps, not host time. Neither gaps, pass sums nor unions are an idle/utilization percentage. Zero passes can mean unavailable timestamps. Dropped records make coverage incomplete. Peaks count tracked submissions, not hardware occupancy.
